messages:
tara.prod: Need a clear, small-surface decision for GA: we ship with an 'eviction-safe prewarm' policy + tapered burst credits. want a yes/no today so roadmap team can finalize slides.
mike.eng: Quick summary of proposal: prewarm instances count toward reserved capacity but are allowed to be slowly tapered (not instant-preempt) when global pressure hits. Tapering = reduce prewarm by 1 instance every 60s per pool until a floor. This avoids sudden 503s.
yoshi.infra: Operational constraints: tapering helps but we need deterministic admission control during drain windows. Propose: admission_priority = [reserved_commit, prewarm_taperable, burst_queue]. Prewarm taper only triggers if region headroom < 5% and AZ spread would be violated.
fiona.se: SEs like tapering because customer UX sees graceful degradation. For GA we should also expose a per-tenant flag 'prewarm_tolerance' (low/standard/high) so SEs can opt-in customers who tolerate more aggressive prewarm.
sam.sales: Pilot feedback: one customer asked specifically for no tapering (they want strict isolation). we should support a "no_taper" contract flag to preserve hard guarantees for enterprise.
nina.finance: Billing question: if prewarms taper, how do we bill partially used prewarm time? propose pro-rated burst minutes with an invoice line "prewarm_tapered_minutes". finance needs simulated taper minutes for 3 pilots to model revenue.
ci-bot: Canary scheduled: dedicated-taper-canary/us-west -> run "taper-stress-3x" at 1768122000. results to #eng-telemetry.
mike.eng: Implementation sketch:
- default taper window: 60s steps, floor = max(1, floor(pool_gpus * 0.05))
- admission_control: deny new prewarm if projected AZ allocation > 85%
- backlog policy: allow burst_queue for short jobs <=45s, otherwise reject with DEDICATED_CAPACITY_QUEUED
- telemetry: dedicated.prewarm.taper_steps, dedicated.prewarm.taper_evictions, dedicated.billing.prewarm_tapered_minutes
fiona.se: UX asks: indicate a "tapering active" banner in console and show a live meter for prewarm_taper_steps with timestamps. Admins can toggle per-tenant no_taper.
sam.sales: Confirming: we'll only allow no_taper for enterprise contracts and it must be explicit. pilot customers default to taper behavior.
yoshi.infra: Also recommend a short cool-off: once tapering completes we hold new prewarms blocked for 10 minutes to let the system stabilize. document in runbook.
nina.finance: Action: need taper minute estimates from eng canary results to model billing.
mike.eng: Action: run canary + simulation and post numbers (taper steps, tapered_minutes). due: Wed EOD (1768200000).
yoshi.infra: Action: produce AZ/regional admission sims showing taper behavior under 2 heavy-tenant scenarios. due: Thu noon.
fiona.se: Action: mock console banner + per-tenant no_taper toggle for demos. due: Thu EOD.
tara.prod: Draft GA acceptance bullets: 1) eviction-safe prewarm taper implemented with default step=60s, floor rule in place; 2) admission control enforces AZ spread and regional headroom thresholds; 3) tenant-level no_taper option for contracted customers; 4) telemetry for taper steps + billing metric prewarm_tapered_minutes; 5) runbook updated with cool-off and cross-region fallback guidance.
sam.sales: Sounds good. if engineering confirms taper doesn't add tail risk, we ship it GA.
mike.eng: TL;DR: We'll validate via canary + sims and report back. If canary shows unacceptable tail latency, fallback to conservative autoscale without taper.
tara.prod: Great. locking this as the recommended GA stance pending canary results. thanks all :thumbsup:
__notes: Single Slack thread; messages concatenated per agents.md; timestamps are plausible
